thread:
maya (PM): quick sync — we shipped the 2.1.0 rollout last night. can we do a fast pass on post-launch priorities? link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/quick/2.1-postlaunch :rocket:

olivia (Eng): saw 3 customer-facing errors in Sentry overnight. i can triage the stack traces in the morning. suspect regression in streaming handler.

sam (QA): flagged two flaky e2e tests that started failing after the deploy. will add the logs to the ticket.

maya (PM): proposal — 48h hotfix window for high-severity bugs (p0/p1). anything else goes into the mini-wave next sprint. criteria below — pls react if you agree.

jordan (Product Ops): +1. want to make sure we capture customer asks separately (do not conflate with crash fixes). customer asks should be scored on: revenue impact, frequency, and engineering cost.

olivia (Eng): agree. quick rubric i used before:
```
Priority decision: bug vs enhancement
- SHOWSTOPPER (p0): crash/data loss -> hotfix
- HIGH (p1): major regression, >1% user impact -> hotfix if low-cost
- MEDIUM (p2): non-critical UX regression or perf -> backlog/mini-wave
- LOW (p3): polish or small requests -> backlog
Engineering cost override: if >3 dev-weeks schedule for next cycle unless P0
```

liam (SRE): also add infra-impact flag — if it requires infra changes (schema, deployment topology), prefer a planned release, not a hotfix. Otherwise risk cascade.

maya (PM): noted. for transparency i'll attach a short triage sheet to the launch doc. Jordan can you prepare the customer-impact scoring column?

jordan (Product Ops): on it. i'll populate with known customer commits and mark any legal/regulatory customers that need priority SLA.

sam (QA): for the flaky e2e tests: i pushed a short repro to the ticket and a temporary test-guard. if we ship a hotfix please coordinate with me to run the guarded suite.

olivia (Eng): quick question — streaming regression fix likely touches gRPC handler. small patch maybe, but needs canary in staging then canary prod. deploy-bot: please schedule a canary for 2.1.1 if we cut a patch.

deploy-bot: sched_canary job created for 2.1.1-canary at 2024-09-12T02:00:00Z (id: job-8732).

maya (PM): timeline suggestion: today — triage + label tickets p0/p1; tomorrow AM — dev owners estimate; tomorrow EOD — cut patch if <= 2 dev-days. otherwise queue for sprint.

olivia (Eng): i'll own the streaming handler triage. expect first estimate by 11:30 PT.

liam (SRE): i'll validate infra-impact by 12:30 PT.

sam (QA): i'll run the guarded regression run at 13:00 PT once olivia's patch is ready.

jordan (Product Ops): i'll finish the customer scoring sheet and ping account execs for any urgent asks.

maya (PM): perfect. if you agree with the plan, react with :thumbsup:. otherwise drop a quick note.

sam (QA): :thumbsup:
